purpose: Characterize how the confirmed wet-regime correctness repair interacts with the existing SWAP TimeControl acceptance/growth/reduction rules without changing those rules.

controller_semantics.nonconvergence_rule: if solver requests dt reduction, reduce by FACT_DT_FLDECT down to DTMIN

interaction_fixture.physics: same 16-node homogeneous wet rainfall/runoff fixture as BOFEK00E
interaction_fixture.note: These are fixed research-fixture values for a paired controller-interaction test, not proposed BOFEK settings and not claimed as universal defaults.

paired_runs: canonical baseline source at 1759caebb7ca3bd62bbee65d9319f5d71d3e73f5 + frozen controller fixture
corrected source + the exact same controller fixture
required_observables: runtime observation with explicit non-benchmark caveat
interpretation_firewall: Any baseline/corrected difference in accepted dt is an interaction with unchanged policy, not a timestep-policy fix.
Any integrated runoff difference under adaptive stepping must be reported separately from frozen-step correctness.
No claim that faster wall time alone establishes correctness.
No DTMIN, DTMAX, NUMBIT_CRIT or factor recommendation may be admitted from this work unit.
